scripts.name: ClassicSword.SwordScript
scripts.source:
-- Fursado

local Tool = script.Parent
local Handle = Tool:WaitForChild("Handle")

local PlayerService = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")


local BaseUrl = "rbxassetid://"

local DamageValues = table.freeze({
	BaseDamage = 5,
	SlashDamage = 10,
	LungeDamage = 30
})

--For R15 avatars
local AnimationIds = table.freeze({
	R15Slash = 522635514,
	R15Lunge = 522638767
})


local Character: Model?
local Player: Player?
local Humanoid: Humanoid?
local Torso: Instance?

--For security
local HitCooldown = {}
local HitDelay = 0.075
local function IsInRange(HitCharacter: Model)
	if not Character then return false end
	
	--print("hit range :: ".. (Character:GetPivot().Position - HitCharacter:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude)
	
	if (HitCharacter:GetPivot().Position - Character:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude > Handle.Size.Z then
		return false
	else
		return true
	end
end

local Damage = DamageValues.BaseDamage

local Grips = table.freeze({
	Up = CFrame.new(0, 0, -1.70000005, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0),
	Out = CFrame.new(0, 0, -1.70000005, 0, 1, 0, 1, -0, 0, 0, 0, -1)
})


local Sounds = {
	Slash = Handle:WaitForChild("SwordSlash") :: Sound,
	Lunge = Handle:WaitForChild("SwordLunge") :: Sound,
	Unsheath = Handle:WaitForChild("Unsheath") :: Sound
}

local ToolEquipped = false

Tool.Grip = Grips.Up
Tool.Enabled = true

function Create(ty)
	return function(data)
		local obj = Instance.new(ty)
		for k, v in data do
			if type(k) == 'number' then
				v.Parent = obj
			else
				obj[k] = v
			end
		end
		return obj
	end
end

function CheckIfAlive()
	if not Character then return false end
	if not Humanoid then return false end
	
	if Humanoid.Health < 0.01 then return false end
	
	return true
end

function IsTeamMate(Player1: Player, Player2: Player)
	if (Player1.Neutral or Player2.Neutral) then return false end
	return (Player1.TeamColor == Player2.TeamColor)
end

function Blow(Hit)
	if not Player then return end
	if not Character then return end
	if not Hit or not Hit.Parent or not CheckIfAlive() or not ToolEquipped then return end
	
	local RightArm = Character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or Character:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
	if not RightArm then
		return
	end
	
	local RightGrip = RightArm:FindFirstChild("RightGrip")
	if not RightGrip or (RightGrip.Part0 ~= Handle and RightGrip.Part1 ~= Handle) then
		return
	end
	
	local HitCharacter = Hit.Parent
	if HitCharacter == Character then
		return
	end
	
	if not IsInRange(HitCharacter) then
		return
	end
	
	if table.find(HitCooldown, HitCharacter) then return end
	table.insert(HitCooldown, HitCharacter)
	
	task.delay(HitDelay, function()
		table.remove(HitCooldown, table.find(HitCooldown, HitCharacter))
	end)
	
	local HitPlayer = PlayerService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(HitCharacter) :: Player?
	if HitPlayer then
		if IsTeamMate(Player, HitPlayer) then return end
	end
	
	local HitHumanoid = HitCharacter:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
	
	if HitHumanoid then
		HitHumanoid:TakeDamage(Damage)	
	end
end


function Attack()
	Damage = DamageValues.SlashDamage
	Sounds.Slash:Play()

	if Humanoid then
		if Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
			local Anim = Instance.new("StringValue")
			Anim.Name = "toolanim"
			Anim.Value = "Slash"
			Anim.Parent = Tool
		elseif Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
			local Anim = Tool:FindFirstChild("R15Slash")
			if Anim then
				local Track = Humanoid:LoadAnimation(Anim)
				Track:Play(0)
			end
		end
	end	
end

function Lunge()
	Damage = DamageValues.LungeDamage

	Sounds.Lunge:Play()
	
	if Humanoid then
		if Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
			local Anim = Instance.new("StringValue")
			Anim.Name = "toolanim"
			Anim.Value = "Lunge"
			Anim.Parent = Tool
		elseif Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
			local Anim = Tool:FindFirstChild("R15Lunge")
			if Anim then
				local Track = Humanoid:LoadAnimation(Anim)
				Track:Play(0)
			end
		end
	end	
	
	task.wait(0.2)
	Tool.Grip = Grips.Out
	task.wait(0.6)
	Tool.Grip = Grips.Up

	Damage = DamageValues.SlashDamage
end

Tool.Enabled = true
LastAttack = 0

function Activated()
	if not Tool.Enabled or not ToolEquipped or not CheckIfAlive() then
		return
	end
	Tool.Enabled = false
	local Tick = RunService.Stepped:Wait()
	if (Tick - LastAttack < 0.2) then
		Lunge()
	else
		Attack()
	end
	
	LastAttack = Tick

	Damage = DamageValues.BaseDamage
	
	local SlashAnim = (Tool:FindFirstChild("R15Slash") or Create("Animation"){
		Name = "R15Slash",
		AnimationId = BaseUrl .. AnimationIds.R15Slash,
		Parent = Tool
	})
	
	local LungeAnim = (Tool:FindFirstChild("R15Lunge") or Create("Animation"){
		Name = "R15Lunge",
		AnimationId = BaseUrl .. AnimationIds.R15Lunge,
		Parent = Tool
	})
	
	Tool.Enabled = true
end

function Equipped()
	Character = Tool.Parent
	
	if not Character then return end
	
	Player = PlayerService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
	Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
	Torso = Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not CheckIfAlive() then
		return
	end
	ToolEquipped = true
	Sounds.Unsheath:Play()
end

function Unequipped()
	Tool.Grip = Grips.Up
	ToolEquipped = false
end

Tool.Activated:Connect(Activated)
Tool.Equipped:Connect(Equipped)
Tool.Unequipped:Connect(Unequipped)

Connection = Handle.Touched:Connect(Blow)

scripts.name: ClassicSword.MouseIcon
scripts.source:
--Made by Luckymaxer

Mouse_Icon = "rbxasset://textures/GunCursor.png"
Reloading_Icon = "rbxasset://textures/GunWaitCursor.png"

Tool = script.Parent

Mouse = nil

function UpdateIcon()
	if Mouse then
		Mouse.Icon = Tool.Enabled and Mouse_Icon or Reloading_Icon
	end
end

function OnEquipped(ToolMouse)
	Mouse = ToolMouse
	UpdateIcon()
end

function OnChanged(Property)
	if Property == "Enabled" then
		UpdateIcon()
	end
end

Tool.Equipped:Connect(OnEquipped)
Tool.Changed:Connect(OnChanged)
